reproducibility_gaps: Declared Python dependencies in setup.py are unversioned, so the exact runtime environment is not reconstructable.
The workflow requires trained external EikoNet models; their exact checkpoint identities and provenance are not bundled in the HypoSVI repository.
The event-pick and station input data used for paper/example reproduction are external rather than bundled as a canonical dataset in the pinned repository.
The README points to an externally hosted Colab example rather than preserving that example as a pinned repository artifact.
Particle initialization uses NumPy randomness without a repository-level deterministic seed in the inspected location workflow.
Hardware/runtime provenance for the published/example calculations is not documented in the pinned repository.
notes: R2 reflects available source, MIT licensing, installation instructions, declared dependencies, explicit algorithm/default parameters, and paper linkage, while exact environment, external EikoNet checkpoints/data, deterministic seed, and hardware provenance remain incomplete.
